tac_surface_normal — 2D tactile op

• Data kinds: image → image

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "tac_surface_normal", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

Usage

Surface-normal z-component (slope map) from the shading gradients, using Horn's shape-from-shading normal parameterisation `n = (-p, -q, 1)/sqrt(1+p^2+q^2) so that nz = 1/sqrt(1+p^2+q^2) with p = gain*gx, q = gain*gy. Flat (uncontacted) gel gives nz = 1, steep indentation walls tend to 0, so the map is already a valid [0,1] encoding. a = gradient gain (1..21x -- how steep the shading is taken to be), b` = pre-smoothing sigma of the image (0..3) to tame sensor noise. Constant input -> all-ones (perfectly flat gel).
